data.name: Cozy Offroad Simulator Together
data.detailed_description:
Set out on a relaxing yet challenging off-road journey in Cozy Offroad Simulator Together, a co-op driving experience built around teamwork, exploration, and surviving nature’s toughest environments. 🚙🌍

Travel through dangerous terrain with a friend as you deliver important resources to remote stations hidden deep in the wilderness. Every route brings new obstacles, changing weather, and situations where preparation matters just as much as driving skill.

🌲 Explore Diverse Regions

Drive through four unique environments, each with its own atmosphere and terrain challenges. Cross muddy forest trails, icy mountain roads, rainy plains filled with slippery dirt paths, and massive desert dunes under extreme heat and dust storms.

🛠 Prepare and Customize Your Vehicle

Choose the right setup before every expedition. Install different tires for mud, snow, or universal driving, improve protection with bumpers and side bars, equip roof cargo racks for supplies, and use a winch system to recover stuck vehicles. Every upgrade changes how your vehicle performs in the wild.

🤝 Built Around Cooperation

Teamwork is essential for survival. Pull your teammate out of deep mud, recover vehicles trapped in snow, and help each other overcome dangerous terrain using realistic recovery mechanics.


⚙️ Realistic Offroad Mechanics

Manage tire pressure for different surfaces, monitor fuel during long trips, and avoid damaging your vehicle. Heavy impacts can make a vehicle unusable, while poor engine management can leave you stranded far from safety.

🌧 Relaxing but Challenging Adventure

Take your time, enjoy the atmosphere, and slowly conquer nature together. Every successful delivery feels rewarding when the road itself becomes part of the challenge.

Start your engines, prepare your vehicles, and explore the wilderness together. 🚙🌲

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-10100 and better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1660 and better
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-11400 and better
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RTX 2080 and better
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
